Name: DE-PurchaseOrders
Description: Extracts purchase orders data from the system.
Statement:
-- +ASSIGNMENTS(Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.PurchaseOrder)
-- +CUSTOMFIELDS(Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.PurchaseOrder)
with
cut as
(
    select  a.DocumentOid as Id,
            max(isnull(convert(int, wsat.AllowPending), 0)) as AllowPending
    from    Assignment a 
                join JobLookup j on j.Id = a.DocumentOid 
                left join WorkflowStateAssignmentType wsat on wsat.AssignmentType = a.AssignmentType and wsat.WorkflowState = j.WorkflowState
    where   a.DocumentTypeName = 'Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.PurchaseOrder' and 
            a.[User] = @CurrentUserId
    group by a.DocumentOid
),
art as
(
        select  poi.PurchaseOrder,
                string_agg(art.Name, ', ') as Articles
        from    PurchaseOrderItem poi, Article art
        where   art.Oid = poi.Article
        group by poi.PurchaseOrder
)
select	doc.Oid,
        doc.Oid as DocumentOid, 
        doc.Number as Name,
        doc.Number,
        doc.Status,
        doc.FinancialStatus,
        doc.CreatedOnUtc,
        doc.CreatedBy as CreatedById,
        usrCb.Name as CreatedBy,
        usrCb.HasImage as CreatedByHasImage,
        doc.ModifiedOnUtc,
        doc.ModifiedBy as ModifiedById,
        usrMb.Name as ModifiedBy,
        usrMb.HasImage as ModifiedByHasImage,
        doc.Date as StartDate,
        doc.DeliveryDate,
        cc.Name as Client,
        cc.Id as ClientId,
        cc.HasImage as ClientHasImage,
        d.Name as Department,
        cnt.Id as ContractId,
        cnt.Name as Contract,
        p.Number + ' - ' + p.Name as Project,
        p.Id as ProjectId,
        e.Name as Estimate,
        e.Oid as EstimateId,
        c.Name as Company,
        c.Id as CompanyId,
        c.HasImage as CompanyHasImage,
        s.NameAndExternalId as Supplier,
        doc.ValueWithoutVat,
        doc.ValueWithVat,
        doc.VatValue,
        doc.Invoiced,
        doc.InvoicedValue,
        doc.ControlledValue,
        doc.[External],
        doc.ExternalId,
        doc.ExternalError,
        wst.Name as StageType,
        isnull(loc.Name, ws.Name) as Stage,
        isnull(ws.Color, wst.Color) as Color,
        iif(bor.Oid is not null, 1, 0) as AlreadyRead,
        iif(cut.Id is null, 0, 1) as CurrentUserInTeam,
        iif(cut.AllowPending is null, 0, cut.AllowPending) as CurrentUserPending,
        iif((select ud.[User] from UserDepartment ud where ud.Department = e.Department and ud.[User] = @CurrentUserId) is null, 0, 1) as CurrentUserInDepartment,
        curr.IsoCode as CurrencyIsoCode,
        curr.Name as Currency,
        art.Articles
from	PurchaseOrder doc
                left join ProjectLookup p on doc.project = p.Id
                left join ContractLookup cnt on cnt.Id = p.Contract
                left join CompanyLookup c on doc.Company = c.Id
                left join Estimate e on doc.Estimate = e.Oid
                left join DepartmentLookup d on e.Department = d.Id
                left join Currency curr on doc.Currency = curr.Oid
                left join ClientLookup cc on e.Client = cc.Id
                left join Supplier s on doc.Supplier = s.Oid
                left join UserLookup usrCb on doc.CreatedBy = usrCb.Id
                left join UserLookup usrMb on doc.ModifiedBy = usrMb.Id
                left join BaseObjectRead bor on bor.ObjectId = doc.Oid and bor.ObjectType = 'Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.PurchaseOrder' and bor.[User] = @CurrentUserId
                join WorkflowState ws on doc.WorkflowState = ws.Oid
                join Configuration cfg on 1 = 1
                left join UserLookup usr on usr.Id = @CurrentUserId
                left join CompanyLookup com on com.Id = usr.Company
                left join LocalizationLanguage lol on lol.Name = isnull(com.DefaultLanguage, cfg.DefaultSystemLanguage)
                left join Localization loc on loc.DocumentOid = ws.Oid and lol.Oid = loc.LocalizationLanguage
                left join cut on cut.Id = doc.Oid
                join WorkflowStateType wst on wst.Oid = ws.WorkflowStateType
                left join art on art.PurchaseOrder = doc.Oid
